rationale: Class 3 aggregate coverage failure. The source schedule contains 141 investment positions, but the output contains only 60, an 81-position shortfall. The filing schedule is internally anchored by total investments of $3,466.654 million at table 12 row 20, matching the statements total at table 7 row 10. Table 9 row 9 is a representative valid position row with issuer, coupon, maturity, principal, cost, and fair value. The independently reconciled source schedule makes the 57.4% count deficit a real extraction coverage error, although the evidence does not isolate one parser branch responsible for all omissions.
